description: This PHP script provides utilities for generating font definition files for Unicode TrueType fonts, including reading UFM files, creating font descriptors, and saving font data. It is used to process font files and generate corresponding PHP configuration files for font embedding.

methods.name: ReadUFM
methods.description: Reads a UFM font metric file and extracts font metrics and character widths, populating a map for character ID to glyph ID.

methods.name: MakeFontDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a font descriptor array for a font based on metrics.

methods.name: MakeWidthArray
methods.description: Generates a PHP array string mapping character codes to widths.

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.description: Saves a string to a specified file.

methods.name: ReadShort
methods.description: Reads a 2-byte unsigned short from a binary file.

methods.name: ReadLong
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte unsigned long from a binary file.

methods.name: CheckTTF
methods.description: Checks if a TrueType font allows embedding by inspecting font license flags.

methods.name: MakeFont
methods.description: Generates a PHP font definition file from a font file and UFM file, possibly embedding the font and creating associated maps.
